event.description: Use per-head block-diagonal attention output projections
event.proposal: family: attention organization; retained incumbent is 3456 parameters at 99.9200%, a +0.92 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0015, full output MQA at 3776/99.95%; same-family failed result: attempt-0018, rank-6 output bottleneck at 3648/0.01% (with attempts 0016–0017 also failing); prior attempts in this family: 5. Hypothesis: the failed low-rank projections removed too much global mixing, so preserve a full-rank d_head-by-d_head output transform independently for each head and remove only cross-head output terms; at d16,h2 this reduces each projection from 256 to 128 parameters and yields 3200 total. This is more informative than another low-rank rank because it preserves exact within-head expressivity and changes only cross-head coupling. Keep affine-free block pre-norms, full final norm, learned positions, MQA, ff17, mixed-digit training, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3456 parameters.
